wildsea.conflictDescription: Still a success, but with a drawback of some kind (such as taking damage or losing a resource). If you’re affecting a track, this usually still lets you mark or clear a box.
wildsea.disasterDescription: A failure that also introduces a narrative complication or drawback of some kind. If you’re affecting a track, this usually doesn’t let you mark or clear at all.
wildsea.name: Name
wildsea.track_update: Click: Update Marks, Shift/Ctrl Click: Update Burn
wildsea.triumphDescription: A complete success with no drawbacks. If you’re affecting a track, this lets you mark or clear a box.
wildsea.twistDescription: An unexpected outcome in addition to the usual result, often something small but potentially useful. This twist can be suggested by any player at the table, but the Firefly has the final say.

TRACKS.label: Label

TRAY.title: Dice Tray
TRAY.handleHint: Drag to move, double-click to put it back in place
TRAY.noPoolHint: You have nothing to draw on: roll 1d6 and treat a triumph as a conflict.

action.label: Action
action.title: Action Roll
action.triumph: A complete success with no drawbacks. If you’re affecting a track, mark or clear a box.
action.conflict: A success with a drawback: you might take damage or lose a resource. If you’re affecting a track, mark or clear a box.
action.disaster: A failure, with a narrative complication or a drawback of some kind. No boxes are marked or cleared.
action.twist: An unexpected outcome in addition to the result. Anyone at the table can suggest it, but the Firefly has the final say.

attack.label: Attack
attack.title: Attack Roll
attack.triumph: Your attack lands with real force: deal damage and, if fitting, an associated effect.
attack.conflict: You hit, dealing damage and perhaps an effect, but something goes wrong: you take damage or an effect, lose a resource or end up in a worse position.
attack.disaster: Your attack misses or deals no damage. You’ll surely take damage or an effect, and may lose a resource or your position.
attack.twist: Twist… or Crit: an unexpected narrative effect, or a critical hit that increases your impact.

defense.label: Defense
defense.title: Defense Roll
defense.triumph: You avoid the threat entirely: no damage, no effects, no lost resources, and your position holds.
defense.conflict: You avoid the worst, but something goes wrong: damage, an effect, a worse position or a lost resource.
defense.disaster: The blow lands in full: you take damage and likely an effect, lose resources and end up in a worse position.
defense.twist: Twist… or Counter: an unexpected narrative effect, or a counter-attack that deals damage (if in range).

resources.label: Resources
resources.title: Resource Roll
resources.triumph: You get the resource you were looking for, perfectly intact.
resources.conflict: You get the resource with a negative tag: still useful, but nothing special.
resources.disaster: You can’t find what you’re looking for, or you spoil the resource while gathering it.
resources.twist: You or another player can give the resource a positive or unique tag.

rest.label: Rest
rest.title: Rest Roll
rest.triumph: Clear two boxes of an aspect, ship rating or burden, or remove two boxes of an injury track.
rest.conflict: Clear one box of an aspect, ship rating or burden, or remove one box of an injury track.
rest.disaster: Mark an extra box of an aspect, ship rating or burden, or add a box to an injury track.
rest.twist: You don’t consume the resource used for the rest.

crafting.label: Crafting
crafting.title: Crafting Roll
crafting.triumph: Your creation grants a temporary aspect: a 2-box track tied to the resources used.
crafting.conflict: A temporary 2-box aspect with drawbacks, or one without drawbacks but with different bonuses than intended.
crafting.disaster: A bizarre ornament or culinary curiosity. It grants no bonus.
crafting.twist: Your creation grants an unexpected bonus: something limited but useful.

rating.label: Ship Rating
rating.title: Ship Rating Roll
rating.triumph: The ship clears the obstacle without trouble.
rating.conflict: The ship clears the obstacle, but marks a box on the rating used for the roll.
rating.disaster: The ship fails to clear the obstacle and marks a box on the rating used for the roll.
rating.twist: An unexpected event in addition to the result, involving the ship, the crew or the surroundings.

TRAY.rollFailed: The roll failed: check the console for details.

NAVAL.attackHint: Armaments and rams deal total impact, which ships and leviathans take as normal impact. Roll a rating for manoeuvres such as ramming (Saws); attacks made by a character are rolled from their sheet.
NAVAL.conflictHint: Conflict: the attack hits, at a cost.
NAVAL.alreadyApplied: The damage of this attack has already been applied. Apply it again?
NAVAL.selfDamageHint: Ramming will most likely damage your own ship too.
NAVAL.ignoredHint: A raider tracked on its ratings ignores anything weaker than total impact.
NAVAL.severityHint: Light damage marks 1-2 boxes, medium 3-4, heavy 5-6.
NAVAL.trackFull: Track full: the raider loses what it represents
NAVAL.disabled: All tracks are full: the raider is neutralised or destroyed
NAVAL.noTargets: There is no ship or raider to target.
NAVAL.noTracks: The target has no tracks to damage.
NAVAL.targetMissing: The target of this attack no longer exists.
NAVAL.notOwner: You cannot update the target ship.

modeHint.equal: Damage goes on the ratings. Total impact counts as normal impact (1 box), anything weaker is ignored.
modeHint.parts: Damage goes on the tracks of the parts below, with their resistances and weaknesses. Anything weaker than a ship armament loses one step of impact.

NAVAL.partHint: Hazards take one box less from damage they resist and one more from damage they are weak to (ctrl-click to pick more than one type).
NAVAL.newPartDetails: A part of the raider's ship or crew, such as the deck guns, the boarding party or the engine.
